_doc: Classes offered at the level 3 choice. needs = minimum dossier counts, needs_max = maximum, needs_past = past-life tags (any). mods are multipliers (*_mult) or flat amounts. 'behaviours' pair with a past life to generate extra classes.

classes.name: Bruiser
classes.quip: You hit things. It is not a personality, but it is a plan.

classes.name: Slinger
classes.quip: Everything is a projectile if you believe in yourself.

classes.name: Hedge Medic
classes.perk: Melee hits may heal; slow regeneration
classes.quip: Unqualified, uninsured, and the best they have got.

classes.name: Sneak
classes.perk: Monsters notice you from half as far
classes.quip: Brave of you to choose a class about not being seen on a television show.

classes.name: Coupon Paladin
classes.perk: One extra item in every loot box; +15% melee damage
classes.drawback: -10% experience (you keep stopping to check prices)
classes.quip: A holy warrior of the clearance aisle.

classes.name: Karaoke Warlord
classes.perk: Double viewers; you and nearby allies deal +15% damage
classes.drawback: Monsters hear you from 60% further away
classes.quip: Nobody asked for an encore. You are doing one anyway.

classes.name: Night-Shift Forklift Savant
classes.quip: Certified to lift. Not certified to throw. And yet.

classes.name: Dough Sergeant
classes.quip: You have been awake since 3 a.m. for nine years. Nothing here scares you.

classes.name: Whistle Tyrant
classes.quip: You once red-carded a nine-year-old. The dungeon respects that.

classes.name: Unlicensed Chiropractor
classes.perk: Melee hits often stun and sometimes heal
classes.quip: You have adjusted a lot of spines today. None of them consented.

classes.name: Professional Bystander
classes.quip: Two levels survived and almost nothing killed. Impressive, in a way we cannot air.

classes.name: Dumpster Alchemist
classes.perk: Can combine up to three items into one throw and invent named concoctions from what works
classes.quip: You kept throwing garbage at problems until one of them exploded. We made it official.

classes.name: Volunteer Hall Monitor
classes.perk: You and nearby allies deal +20% damage; slow regeneration
classes.quip: Nobody elected you. You brought your own sash.

classes.name: Disgraced Mascot
classes.drawback: Every monster wants you first; -20% melee damage
classes.quip: You have died so often the audience made you a costume.

classes.name: Human Pinata
classes.perk: Things that bite you get hurt; two extra items in every loot box
classes.quip: Hit you enough and prizes fall out. We checked.

behaviours.text: +50% viewers, monsters hear you from 40% further
One extra item per loot box, -10% speed
